es.hero_h1:
RGM para farma y OTC:
del embarque al mostrador.
es.hero_lead: En OTC el sell-in al canal es visible y el sell-out al shopper es ciego, el trade spend se mide por agregado y la venta la cierra tanto el mostrador como el anaquel, con demanda estacional por síntoma. Imberion hace visible el sell-out y el gross-to-net, gobierna las palancas de RGM por canal y presentación, y convierte la recomendación de mostrador en capacidad medible.
es.diag_note: El fabricante típico de OTC está en nivel 1 o 2 en trade spend (concedido como condición de hecho, gross-to-net diluido) y en la recomendación de mostrador (dejada al azar o al genérico). Ahí está la mayor recuperación, y el sell-out visible la habilita.
es.s2_eyebrow: Lo que Imberion trae a salud y farma
es.s2_lead: Se aplica lo que la operación necesita, anclado al salto de nivel. Todos los productos del catálogo aplican; aquí, los de mayor tracción.

es.cap1_p: La bolsa más grande del OTC. Trade terms con pago por desempeño y gross-to-net visible por cliente y SKU; reasignar el gasto improductivo libera puntos de revenue neto sin recortar la inversión total.
es.cap2_p: Se decide sobre lo que el shopper se llevó, no sobre lo que el canal compró. Se ve el SKU que vende pero no se reabastece en el pico del síntoma y el que solo infló el sell-in, con el riesgo de caducidad del inventario empujado.
es.cap3_p: Buena parte de la actividad promocional no genera incremental: regala margen en el pico que ya iba a ocurrir. Separar incremental de canibalización ex-ante, sobre baseline estacional, es la bolsa más rápida.
es.cap4_p: Se detecta dónde se pierde por precio o por el genérico, y dónde hay espacio para defender el premium. Captura precio, promoción y share of shelf de marca y genérico en el punto de venta real, sin el rezago del panel.
es.cap5_p: La recomendación que en la farmacia da el mostrador, trasladada a la conversación. Atención al canal y al shopper 24/7 que toma pedidos y empuja el mix objetivo en cada reabasto, dentro del claim permitido.
es.cap6_p: Convierte la recomendación de mostrador en capacidad instalada y medible, trazable al sell-out por farmacia. Es la palanca de sell-out propia del OTC, hoy dejada al azar o al genérico, vuelta argumento y señal continua.

en.s1_h2: Where does the commercial operation stand today?
en.s1_lead: Mark the level on each dimension. It is not a grade: it locates where the operation stands and where it should go. Each dimension to move up a level is an initiative in the roadmap.
en.diag_cta: Take it to an Imberion Checkup
en.ctastrip_h2: How far can the operation go?
en.ctastrip_p: The Imberion Checkup x-rays the operation and delivers an initiative matrix with a business case and an actionable playbook. The low-risk way in.
en.lvl1_d: By judgment, no rule or data.
en.lvl2_d: Rules and data exist, but go unfollowed and unused.
en.lvl3_d: Decisions by value and segment, with guardrails and measurement.
en.lvl4_d: Continuous suggestions, with simulation and a learning loop.
en.hero_h1:
RGM for pharma and OTC:
from shipment to counter.
en.hero_lead: In OTC, sell-in to the channel is visible while sell-out to the shopper is blind, trade spend is measured in aggregate, and the sale is closed as much by the counter as by the shelf, with demand that is seasonal by symptom. Imberion makes sell-out and gross-to-net visible, governs the RGM levers by channel and pack, and turns the counter recommendation into a measurable capability.
en.diag_note: The typical OTC maker sits at level 1 or 2 on trade spend (granted as a given, gross-to-net diluted) and on counter recommendation (left to chance or to the generic). That is where the largest recovery lives, and visible sell-out enables it.
en.s2_eyebrow: What Imberion brings to health & pharma
en.s2_lead: We apply what the operation needs, anchored to the level jump. Every product in the catalog applies; here, the ones with the most traction.

en.cap1_p: OTC's biggest bag. Pay-for-performance trade terms and gross-to-net visible by customer and SKU; reallocating unproductive spend frees points of net revenue without cutting total investment.
en.cap2_p: Decisions run on what the shopper took, not on what the channel bought. It surfaces the SKU that sells but is not restocked at the symptom peak and the one that only inflated sell-in, with the expiry risk of pushed inventory.
en.cap3_p: Much promotional activity generates no incremental: it gives away margin at a peak that was coming anyway. Splitting incremental from cannibalization ex-ante, on a seasonal baseline, is the fastest bag.
en.cap4_p: It shows where price or shelf is lost to the generic, and where there is room to defend the premium. It captures price, promotion and share of shelf for brand and generic at the real point of sale, without panel lag.
en.cap5_p: The recommendation the counter gives in the pharmacy, moved into the conversation. Channel and shopper attention 24/7 that takes orders and pushes the target mix on every restock, within the permitted claim.
en.cap6_p: It turns the counter recommendation into an installed, measurable capability, traceable to sell-out per pharmacy. It is OTC's own sell-out lever, today left to chance or to the generic, turned into argument and continuous signal.

pt.hero_h1:
RGM para farma e OTC:
do embarque ao balcão.
pt.hero_lead: No OTC o sell-in para o canal é visível e o sell-out para o shopper é cego, o trade spend é medido por agregado e a venda é fechada tanto pelo balcão quanto pela gôndola, com demanda sazonal por sintoma. A Imberion torna visíveis o sell-out e o gross-to-net, governa as alavancas de RGM por canal e embalagem, e transforma a recomendação de balcão em capacidade mensurável.
pt.diag_note: O fabricante típico de OTC está no nível 1 ou 2 em trade spend (concedido como condição de fato, gross-to-net diluído) e na recomendação de balcão (deixada ao acaso ou ao genérico). É ali que está a maior recuperação, e o sell-out visível a habilita.
